item.title: Unsightly and intimidating, 3rd September
item.description:
The bench next to Subway take away restaurant on the corner of Rye Lane & Peckham High Street is a constant nuisance with groups of drunk and drugged people congregating , causing excessive noise (playing loud music , drinking alcohol , shouting and smoking drugs ) They cause an unpleasant and unsafe environment to live in for the residents and passers by. This group of people also likes to occupy the space by Vaalee Shop (66 Peckham High Street) blocking the pavement, drinking,smoking and spitting( In Southwark, spitting on the pavement is widely classified as anti-social behaviour and treated as an environmental offence akin to littering, which can result in a Fixed Penalty Notice (FPN) ) Playing loud music in public spaces is generally prohibited without a license or permit. In the London Borough of Southwark, amplified music and generators are explicitly banned in public parks and open spaces to keep areas peaceful Thus very area must be patrolled by the Community Safety Team to ensure that we( the community) are free from this dangerous people! Please assist

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 66, Peckham High Street, Peckham, Greater London

item.title: Tree Encroaching on Street Light and Utility Wires, 3rd September
item.description:
​I am reporting a mature tree adjacent to the residential hedge and public footway that is causing two main obstructions it has not been pruned all year and huge branches are constantly breaking off: ​Streetlight Obstruction: The tree canopy has overgrown and enveloped a street lighting column, significantly blocking light output onto the pavement and roadway. ​Utility Cable Encroachment: Tree branches are growing directly into and pressing against overhead utility wires, creating a risk of damage or service disruption during high winds. ​Location Details: Adjacent to the property hedge near the public footway. Requested Action: Please inspect the tree and arrange urgent crown reduction and pruning to restore full street lighting functionality and safely clear the overhead utility lines.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Kersey Gardens, Mottingham, Greater London

item.description:

item.title: Heath street NW3, 3rd September
item.description:
The west side of pavement has recently been resurfaced. Instead of resurfacing with paving stones in keeping with the neighbourhood, it has been tarred in the most simple and unattractive manner and with a shocking and unacceptable finish. This is so disappointing after weeks of closed access to the pavement. For a council that prides itself on blocking construction and signage that it deems to be out of character to the neighbourhood, this latest work is an eyesore. It leaves us wondering what kind of management oversaw this job. We recommend that this whole stretch of payment gets appropriately redone. What a shame to use and waste tax payer money in this way!!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 75, Heath Street, Belsize Park, Greater London
